AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized administrator account permitted to access the JCC Sondu admin portal.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

email.description: Verified Google account email address of the administrator.

createdBy.description: UID of the admin who granted access.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

AdminEmail.title: AdminEmail
AdminEmail.description: Authorized Google email address manually keyed in by an administrator to grant JCC Sondu admin portal access.

email.description: Normalized lowercase Google account email address authorized for admin access.

displayName.description: Display name or ministry role label for this administrator.

createdBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator who added this email.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the email was authorized.

AdminNumber.title: AdminNumber
AdminNumber.description: Phone number added by an admin to use as a sender or contact number for mass SMS.

label.description: Descriptive label for this admin phone number (e.g., Pastor Office Line).

isDefault.description: Whether this number is selected by default when composing mass SMS.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin who added this number.

ownerEmail.description: Email of the admin who added this number.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the number was added.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the number was last updated.

Congregant.title: Congregant
Congregant.description: Congregant record stored by JCC Sondu admins for directory management and mass SMS outreach.

phoneNumber.description: Normalized E.164 phone number of the congregant.

createdBy.description: UID of the admin who created this congregant record.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the congregant record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the congregant record was last updated.

SmsCampaign.title: SmsCampaign
SmsCampaign.description: Mass SMS dispatch record initiated by an administrator.

senderNumber.description: Admin phone number associated with this campaign.

senderLabel.description: Label of the sender number used.

message.description: Body of the mass SMS message.

targetFilter.description: Audience filter selected by the administrator.

sentCount.description: Count of messages accepted by the SMS carrier.

failedCount.description: Count of messages that failed to dispatch.

status.description: Overall dispatch status reported by the SMS backend.

provider.description: SMS gateway provider used for dispatch (e.g., africastalking, twilio, unconfigured).

errorMessage.description: Error summary when dispatch fails or is unconfigured.

createdBy.description: UID of the admin who initiated the campaign.

createdByEmail.description: Email of the admin who initiated the campaign.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the campaign was logged.

SmsCampaignRecipient.title: SmsCampaignRecipient
SmsCampaignRecipient.description: Per-recipient delivery outcome sub-record for a mass SMS campaign.

congregantId.description: Document ID of the targeted congregant.

congregantName.description: Snapshot name of the congregant at dispatch time.

providerMessageId.description: External SMS provider message reference if accepted.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the recipient log was created.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Authorized admin users allowed into the JCC Sondu admin portal.

/adminEmails/{emailId}.description: Authorized Google email addresses manually added by admins for portal access.

/adminNumbers/{numberId}.description: Phone numbers registered by administrators for mass SMS outreach.

/congregants/{congregantId}.description: Congregant directory containing name, gender, and phone number.

/smsCampaigns/{campaignId}/recipients/{r.description: Subcollection storing per-recipient dispatch results for each SMS campaign.
